handoff_note: Approved (2026-10-25, see Notes): build with the proposed sources. Proposal (claude-loop3, 2026-10-25): words and frequencies from Mozilla Common Voice sentence text (CC0, github.com/common-voice/common-voice server/data/<lang>) (ar: only 3.9 MB of sentences, so coverage and ranking are thin; no larger permissive Arabic list found), plus a Latin-to-Arabic table built by hand, including the digits people use in Arabizi (2 ء, 3 ع, 7 ح). Pack about 1 MB. Also for the person: should Arabizi digits be supported, or plain letters only? Not usable: hermitdave FrequencyWords and wordfreq (their word data is CC-BY-SA 4.0), Leipzig corpora (non-commercial).
